'''Atsuko Enomoto''' (Japanese: '''榎本温子''' ''Enomoto Atsuko'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Enomoto was born on November 1, 1979, in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, as the youngest of three sisters. She became a voice actress while she was still in high school, and also pursued a singing career. Enomoto had been affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|81 Produce}} until her departure in 2015. She was married to fellow voice actress {{wp|Mark Ishii}} from March 2016 to August 2018. Enomoto has occasionally voiced characters for the {{pkmn|animated series}} during the {{aniseries|GS}} and {{aniseries|RS}}, and her best known role during that time was {{OBP|Pokémon Ranger|Ranger series}} [[Solana]]. She briefly returned during {{aniseries|XY}}, voicing [[Beatrice]], a [[character of the day]].
